label: mid-copy position (recalling original tokens 3-4) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only during the copy phase, never on original-token or delimiter steps, and only on repeated inputs (in_first==0 always holds, which follows from the copy phase). Mostly on steps outputting original tokens 3-4 (recall_idx 2-4 holds ~85% of mass), with steps t=10-13 most common, and much more often in long sequences: L=9 holds 53% of mass, L=8 30%, and almost none for L<=5. A smaller bump at the last outputs of L=9 sequences (t=16-17). The copy input token modulates how often it fires (z, s, c, o highest, z about 3.6x lift), and the top activations come from z/s inputs at recall_idx 3 in L=8-9 sequences, but no token rule is clean. Positional predicate: precision about 0.44, F1 about 0.54; many mid-copy steps in long sequences stay inactive, and token identity explains only part of that.
